description.en: Karya is a portfolio for product designers and UI/UX freelancers: present case studies with project details, show interactive design experiments, list your experience, and let clients reach you through a contact form.
description.id: Karya adalah portofolio untuk desainer produk dan freelancer UI/UX: tampilkan studi kasus beserta detail proyek, pamerkan eksperimen desain interaktif, cantumkan pengalaman, dan terima pesan klien lewat form kontak.
